decisions.reason: Adding dimensions for red-marked walls does not change the furnishings, refrigerator inclusion, or separate-drawing requirement.
The source adds annotations to the plan deliverable but does not change the content or purpose of the initial concept sketch.
Dimensioning marked walls does not change the corridor narrowing method or space-optimization objective.
The source requests documentation of wall dimensions and does not change which partition walls are preserved, demolished, removed, or constructed.
The wall-dimension annotation request does not resolve or alter the unit 1 ensuite arrangement, fixtures, doors, or existing layout ambiguity.
The source does not change the location or independence of the common and unit entrance doors.
Adding wall measurements to the plan does not change the unit 1 common bathroom boundary, fixtures, or relationship to the ensuite.
The annotation request does not change the unit 3 bathroom door position or its kitchen-counter clearance constraint.
The source does not alter the required bathroom or the left-wall locations of its drain and shower.
Wall dimension annotations do not change bathroom drainage placement, connection targets, or the unresolved drainage scope.
The source does not change the requirement to preserve existing exterior windows.
The source does not alter the unit 2 bathroom position or centered bathroom-door requirement.
